description: GH116 family-wide test: is the PC-type architecture (a shortened N-terminal domain directly preceding an intact catalytic region) seen in natural GH116 proteins? Distribution of PF12215 match length and of the residue extent preceding the PF04685 catalytic match across 5622 proteins
code:
import json, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
cat = json.load(open("out/sweep_PF04685.json"))
nt  = json.load(open("out/sweep_PF12215.json"))
print("PF04685 proteins:", len(cat), " PF12215 proteins:", len(nt))

accs = sorted(set(cat) | set(nt))
rows=[]
for a in accs:
    L   = (cat.get(a) or nt.get(a))[0]
    db  = (cat.get(a) or nt.get(a))[1]
    cl  = cat.get(a,[None,None,[]])[2]
    nl  = nt.get(a,[None,None,[]])[2]
    cst = min(s for s,e in cl) if cl else None            # start of catalytic match
    ntlen = max((e-s+1) for s,e in nl) if nl else 0       # longest N-terminal domain match
    ntst  = min(s for s,e in nl) if nl else None
    rows.append(dict(acc=a,length=L,db=db,cat_start=cst,nt_len=ntlen,nt_start=ntst,
                     n_ext=(cst-1) if cst else None))
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df.to_csv("out/gh116_family.csv",index=False)

ref = {"CG33090-PB (Q7KT91)":dict(nt_len=329,n_ext=504,length=948),
       "CG33090-PC (X2JE45)":dict(nt_len=247,n_ext=355,length=799),
       "human GBA2 (Q9HCG7)":dict(nt_len=305,n_ext=520,length=927)}

both = df[(df.cat_start.notna()) & (df.nt_len>0)]
print(f"\nproteins with both domains: {len(both)}")
print("PF12215 match length: median %.0f, IQR %.0f-%.0f, 5th pct %.0f, 1st pct %.0f, min %d"
      % (both.nt_len.median(), both.nt_len.quantile(.25), both.nt_len.quantile(.75),
         both.nt_len.quantile(.05), both.nt_len.quantile(.01), both.nt_len.min()))
for k,v in ref.items():
    pct = 100*(both.nt_len < v["nt_len"]).mean()
    pct2 = 100*(both.n_ext < v["n_ext"]).mean()
    print(f"  {k:22s} nt_len={v['nt_len']:4d} -> {pct:5.1f} pct of family shorter | "
          f"n_ext={v['n_ext']:4d} -> {pct2:5.1f} pct of family shorter")

# proteins lacking any PF12215 match
no_nt = df[(df.cat_start.notna()) & (df.nt_len==0)]
print(f"\nPF04685 without any PF12215 match: {len(no_nt)}")
print("  their n_ext (residues before the catalytic match): median %.0f, IQR %.0f-%.0f"
      % (no_nt.n_ext.median(), no_nt.n_ext.quantile(.25), no_nt.n_ext.quantile(.75)))
print("  n_ext>=300 (N-terminal region present but undetected by PF12215): %d (%.0f%%)"
      % ((no_nt.n_ext>=300).sum(), 100*(no_nt.n_ext>=300).mean()))
print("  n_ext<100 (catalytic domain genuinely near the N terminus): %d (%.0f%%)"
      % ((no_nt.n_ext<100).sum(), 100*(no_nt.n_ext<100).mean()))
print("  median total length of the n_ext<100 group: %.0f" % no_nt[no_nt.n_ext<100].length.median())

# PC-like architecture: partial N-terminal domain starting very close to the protein N terminus
pc_like = both[(both.nt_start<=60) & (both.nt_len<280) & (both.nt_len>150)]
print(f"\nPC-like (PF12215 starts <=60, match length 150-280): {len(pc_like)} of {len(both)} "
      f"({100*len(pc_like)/len(both):.2f}%)")
print(pc_like[["acc","length","db","nt_start","nt_len","cat_start"]].head(12).to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.8))
ax=axes[0]
ax.hist(both.nt_len,bins=60,color="#6b8cba",edgecolor="none")
cols={"CG33090-PB (Q7KT91)":"#2a7a2a","CG33090-PC (X2JE45)":"#c0392b","human GBA2 (Q9HCG7)":"#7d3c98"}
for k,v in ref.items():
    ax.axvline(v["nt_len"],color=cols[k],lw=2)
    ax.text(v["nt_len"],ax.get_ylim()[1]*0.95,k.split()[0]+("-PC" if "PC" in k else ""),
            rotation=90,va="top",ha="right",color=cols[k],fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("PF12215 (GH116 N-terminal domain) match length, residues")
ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title("A  N-terminal domain match length across 5319 GH116 proteins")

ax=axes[1]
sub=df[df.cat_start.notna()]
ax.scatter(sub.length,sub.n_ext,s=4,alpha=0.25,color="#6b8cba",label="GH116 proteins")
for k,v in ref.items():
    ax.scatter([v["length"]],[v["n_ext"]],s=70,color=cols[k],edgecolor="k",zorder=5,label=k)
ax.set_xlim(0,1600); ax.set_ylim(0,900)
ax.set_xlabel("protein length, residues")
ax.set_ylabel("residues preceding the PF04685 catalytic match")
ax.set_title("B  Extent of chain N-terminal to the catalytic domain")
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
